compatibility: Opt-in: TP=3 with expert parallelism; other TP sizes are unchanged. The vision tower runs data-parallel at TP3.
details: At TP3, MLA heads are padded 64->72, KDA heads 64->66 and the shared expert 2048->2112 with zero weights, so outputs match the unpadded model; routed experts use expert parallelism.
Optional FP8 weight-only decode for the large BF16 projections (VLLM_GLM53_FP8_DENSE=1) and a low-latency GEMM plan for TP3 decode shapes.
FlashInfer autotune caches now hold every rank's entries and all ranks load them consistently; with expert parallelism a warm start could hang.
Based on BoxTops4Coochie's GLM-5.3-Flash TP3 port.
